title: Bras, kets and complex inner products
objectives: Construct conjugate transposes and calculate inner products.
Check normalization and orthogonality and interpret normalized overlap.
prerequisites: Chapter 2’s vectors, basis labels and matrix multiplication; elementary algebra. New notation is developed in the text.

quizzes.question: What is the squared norm of v=(1,i)?
feedback: That is the incorrect non-conjugated self-product.
Squared norm is real and nonnegative.

quizzes.question: If an inner product equals i/2, what is its squared magnitude?
feedback: The ordinary square is −1/4; probability uses squared magnitude.
